target_customer: Non-technical teams and individuals who want charts from spreadsheet-like data without writing code
problem: Turning raw data into suitable charts and dashboards required BI tools or code, which small teams found heavy.
business_model: No-code data visualization SaaS (monetization not disclosed)

founders.name: William Wolf
founders.background_notes: The YC page lists William Wolf, while TechCrunch and Airtable name a co-founder Will Strimling. These may be the same person under different names; not resolved.

founders.name: Justin Woodbridge
founders.background_notes: Airtable newsroom says the two founders first met at a research lab.

technical_complexity.rationale: Chart-type recommendation and dashboard assembly on top of arbitrary tabular data is standard front-end plus heuristics work; a four-person team could ship it.

defensibility.rationale: No sourced data or integration moat; Airtable bought the team and assets and planned to fold the features into its own product within months.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Airtable acquired the team and assets in August 2021 and shut the standalone product down.

market_need_then: Not documented in the sources opened. Bayes founder said Airtable was a major inspiration, which suggests demand for simple visualization on top of flexible databases.

branding.domain_note: YC lists bayes.com as the website; how it was obtained is not stated and the site did not load (HTTP 525).

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence about the brand beyond acquisition coverage; four-person company, product shut down within months of acquisition.

outcome_analysis: Bayes was a four-person no-code visualization startup from YC Summer 2019 that never publicly disclosed funding or traction. In August 2021 Airtable bought the team and assets as its first acquisition, shut the standalone product down and folded the functionality into Airtable, so the outcome reads as a soft landing for the team rather than a proven product business. Deal terms were not disclosed.
